instructions.zh: 打开游戏安装文件夹。如果通过 Steam 安装，可在库中右键点击游戏，选择「管理」→「浏览本地文件」。
instructions.en: Open the game's installation folder. For a Steam installation, right-click the game in your library and choose Manage → Browse local files.

instructions.zh: 在游戏安装文件夹内，依次打开 platform → steam → ue4ss。
instructions.en: Inside the game's installation folder, open platform → steam → ue4ss.

instructions.zh: 选择 UE4SS.log 和 UE4SS-settings.ini。它们在同一个文件夹中；缺少其中一个时，也可以先添加找到的文件。
instructions.en: Select UE4SS.log and UE4SS-settings.ini from that folder. If one is missing, you can still add the file you found.
